items.titleOriginal: IBM finds 92% of companies hit by AI security breaches lacked basic access controls
items.summaryOriginal: According to IBM, 92 percent of companies that experienced an AI security incident had inadequate access controls for their AI systems. The model itself was rarely the problem. The article IBM finds 92% of companies hit by AI security breaches lacked basic access controls appeared first on The Decoder .
items.author: Thomas Joos
items.importanceReasonZh: 该新闻提供了关于AI安全事件中访问控制重要性的具体统计数据，对企业安全实践有指导意义。
items.importanceReasonEn: The news provides specific statistics on the importance of access control in AI security incidents, which is instructive for enterprise security practices.
items.titleZh: IBM发现92%遭遇AI安全事件的公司缺乏基本访问控制
items.titleEn: IBM finds 92% of companies hit by AI security breaches lacked basic access controls
items.summaryZh: 根据IBM的数据，92%遭遇AI安全事件的公司对其AI系统缺乏足够的访问控制。问题很少出在模型本身。
items.summaryEn: According to IBM, 92 percent of companies that experienced an AI security incident had inadequate access controls for their AI systems. The model itself was rarely the problem.
items.detailZh:
IBM发布了一份报告，指出在遭遇AI安全事件的公司中，有92%的公司对其AI系统缺乏足够的访问控制。这意味着大多数安全漏洞并非源于AI模型本身的缺陷，而是由于企业未能实施基本的访问管理措施。报告强调，访问控制是保护AI系统安全的第一道防线，但许多企业忽视了这一点。

该报告基于对多个行业公司的调查，发现许多公司在部署AI时，没有充分考虑到安全访问控制的重要性。这导致敏感数据泄露、模型被篡改或滥用等风险。IBM建议企业应优先加强访问控制，包括身份验证、权限管理和监控，以降低AI安全风险。
keyPointsZh: 92%的AI安全事件与访问控制不足有关。
AI模型本身很少是安全问题的根源。
企业需要加强访问控制以保护AI系统。
items.impactZh: 对于企业而言，这一发现提醒他们在部署AI时，必须将安全访问控制作为首要任务，否则可能面临数据泄露和系统被滥用的风险。对于安全行业，这强调了访问控制工具和最佳实践的重要性。
actionStepsZh: 审查并加强AI系统的访问控制策略。
实施多因素身份验证和权限管理。
定期监控AI系统的访问日志。

items.titleOriginal: Devtools must be open source (exe.dev)
items.summaryOriginal: My comment on Devtools must be open source (exe.dev) — Hacker News. One of the arguments for open source software for end-users has always been the freedom to examine and modify how that software works. The reality for most people - even expert programmers - has been that the freedom is more about being able to lean on other people to do that. Most people can't justify the time commitment needed to read and then modify the code for tools they use very often. I think LLMs have changed that equation in a way that makes the original dream much more feasible. Several times a day I'll prompt regular Claude chat to "Clone x/y from GitHub and tell me how Z works". Getting software to compile in order to start hacking on it used to be enough friction that I often wouldn't bother. Now I treat that as a zero time investment challenge: tell Codex or Claude Code to checkout and build X and then come back ten minutes later and see how it got on. I'm not habitually modifying the software I use yet, but I can see a path to that which didn't exist a year or so ago. Tags: hacker-news , open-source , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-assisted-programming
items.importanceReasonZh: 该观点反映了AI对开发者工作流的实际影响，具有实践指导意义，但属于个人经验分享，缺乏系统性证据。
items.importanceReasonEn: The opinion reflects the practical impact of AI on developer workflows, offering actionable insights, but it is based on personal experience and lacks systematic evidence.

The friction of compiling and modifying code has been reduced by AI assistants like Codex and Claude Code, which can quickly clone, build, and understand code.
items.detailZh: 作者在Hacker News上对“开发者工具必须开源”的帖子发表评论。他指出，开源软件的传统优势在于用户可以自由检查和修改代码，但现实中大多数人（甚至专业程序员）很少真正去阅读和修改代码，因为时间成本太高。然而，LLM的出现改变了这一状况。作者提到，他每天多次使用Claude聊天来“从GitHub克隆x/y并告诉我Z是如何工作的”。过去，编译和修改代码的摩擦常常让他放弃，但现在他可以将此视为零时间投入的挑战：让Codex或Claude Code检出并构建项目，十分钟后回来查看进展。虽然作者尚未习惯性地修改软件，但他认为这条路已经变得可行，而一年前还不存在。
keyPointsZh: 开源软件的自由在于检查和修改代码，但现实中很少有人这样做。
LLM降低了阅读和理解代码的门槛，使得克隆和构建项目变得容易。
作者使用Claude、Codex等AI助手快速克隆和构建代码，节省时间。
作者认为AI辅助编程使得修改软件成为可能，但尚未形成习惯。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，AI辅助编程工具可以显著降低理解和修改开源代码的障碍，提高工作效率。对于开源社区，这可能促进更多人参与代码审查和贡献。对于AI行业，这展示了LLM在编程领域的实际应用价值。
actionStepsZh: 尝试使用AI助手（如Claude、Codex）克隆并构建你感兴趣的开源项目。
利用AI解释代码库的结构和关键功能，快速理解项目。
将AI辅助编程纳入日常开发流程，减少重复性工作。

items.titleOriginal: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
items.summaryOriginal: AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report. Financial losses more than doubled from $192 million to $484 million, and about 600,000 cases of digital extortion involving deepfakes were recorded. The article Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa appeared first on The Decoder .
items.author: Matthias Bastian
items.importanceReasonZh: 该报告提供了关于AI在非洲网络犯罪中作用的具体数据，对理解AI的负面影响和网络安全趋势有重要参考价值。
items.importanceReasonEn: The report provides concrete data on AI's role in cybercrime in Africa, which is important for understanding AI's negative impacts and cybersecurity trends.
items.titleZh: 国际刑警组织称人工智能已成为非洲网络犯罪的“核心操作驱动力”

items.summaryEn: AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report. Financial losses more than doubled from $192 million to $484 million, and about 600,000 cases of digital extortion involving deepfakes were recorded.
items.detailZh: 国际刑警组织发布的一份新报告显示，人工智能已成为非洲网络犯罪的“核心操作驱动力”。报告指出，在非洲报告的55%的网络犯罪中，AI都参与其中。财务损失从1.92亿美元激增至4.84亿美元，翻了一倍多。此外，报告还记录了约60万起涉及深度伪造的数字勒索案件。这些数据凸显了AI技术在犯罪活动中的滥用，以及非洲地区在网络安全方面面临的严峻挑战。
keyPointsZh: AI参与了非洲55%的已报告网络犯罪。

items.impactZh: 这一报告对非洲及全球的网络安全政策制定者、企业和个人都有重要影响。它提醒人们，AI技术不仅带来便利，也可能被用于犯罪活动。企业和个人需要加强网络安全防护，特别是对深度伪造和AI驱动的欺诈保持警惕。同时，政府和国际组织需要加强合作，制定相应的法规和应对措施。

items.summaryEn: SenseTime releases SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview, a lightweight native unified multimodal model based on the NEO-Unify architecture, achieving generation and editing quality comparable to commercial closed-source models with only 8B-MoT parameters.

参数规模仅8B-MoT，但生成和编辑质量接近闭源模型。

items.titleOriginal: Google Agent Skills 幕后：如何构建、测试与规模化
items.summaryOriginal: Google Agent Skills 团队详解其开源技能库的构建与治理流程：项目始于 Google Cloud Next 2026 前的"swarm"冲刺，发布后 GitHub 星标超 15，000。为保证规模化下的质量，每个技能须通过标准化目录结构、CI/CD 流水线（含 linter、链接检查、AI 辅助清单）及提交时与每周的持续评估，并优先引用远程 MCP 工具。
items.author: Google AI：DEV 作者专属（RSS）
items.importanceReasonZh: 该内容提供了 Google 官方团队在构建和规模化开源技能库时的具体实践，包括标准化流程、CI/CD 和评估机制，对开发者有实际参考价值，且来源为官方渠道，可信度高。
items.importanceReasonEn: This content provides concrete practices from the official Google team on building and scaling an open-source skill library, including standardized processes, CI/CD, and evaluation mechanisms, which are practically valuable for developers, and the source is official, so credibility is high.
items.titleZh: Google Agent Skills 幕后：如何构建、测试与规模化
items.titleEn: Behind the Scenes of Google Agent Skills: How We Build, Test, and Scale
items.summaryZh: Google Agent Skills 团队详解其开源技能库的构建与治理流程：项目始于 Google Cloud Next 2026 前的"swarm"冲刺，发布后 GitHub 星标超 15,000。为保证规模化下的质量，每个技能须通过标准化目录结构、CI/CD 流水线（含 linter、链接检查、AI 辅助清单）及提交时与每周的持续评估，并优先引用远程 MCP 工具。
items.summaryEn: The Google Agent Skills team details the build and governance process for their open-source skill library: the project began with a 'swarm' sprint before Google Cloud Next 2026, and after release, the GitHub stars exceeded 15,000. To ensure quality at scale, each skill must pass a standardized directory structure, CI/CD pipeline (including linters, link checks, AI-assisted checklists), and continuous evaluation at commit time and weekly, with a preference for referencing remote MCP tools.
items.detailZh: Google Agent Skills 团队在官方博客中分享了其开源技能库的构建与治理经验。该项目始于 Google Cloud Next 2026 前的一次内部"swarm"冲刺，团队集中开发了首批技能，并在发布后迅速获得超过 15,000 个 GitHub 星标。为了在规模扩大的同时保持质量，团队建立了一套严格的流程：每个技能必须遵循标准化的目录结构，并通过 CI/CD 流水线进行自动化检查，包括 linter、链接检查和 AI 辅助的清单审核。此外，技能在提交时和每周都会进行持续评估，以确保其功能正常且符合最佳实践。团队还优先推荐使用远程 MCP（Model Context Protocol）工具，以增强技能的互操作性和可维护性。
keyPointsZh: Google Agent Skills 项目始于 Cloud Next 2026 前的内部冲刺，发布后 GitHub 星标超 15,000。
每个技能必须遵循标准化目录结构，并通过 CI/CD 流水线（linter、链接检查、AI 辅助清单）进行自动化检查。
技能在提交时和每周进行持续评估，确保质量和功能正常。
团队优先引用远程 MCP 工具，以提升互操作性和可维护性。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，该文章提供了构建高质量开源技能库的实用指南，包括标准化流程、自动化检查和持续评估机制。这些实践可以帮助开发者提升自己项目的可维护性和可靠性，尤其是在团队协作和规模扩展时。对于行业而言，Google 的这套方法可能成为 Agent 技能开发的参考标准，推动生态系统的健康发展。
actionStepsZh: 采用标准化的目录结构来组织技能代码，便于维护和审查。
在 CI/CD 流水线中集成 linter、链接检查和 AI 辅助清单，实现自动化质量门禁。
建立提交时和定期的持续评估机制，确保技能始终可用。

Subscribe now Self-sustaining and self-replicating AI viruses are here:…Open weight LLMs + a well-designed harness = a persistent, self-sufficient virus…AI researchers have built a prototype computer virus which […]
items.detailZh:
本期Import AI通讯重点报道了AI研究中的几个关键话题。首先，文章指出AI研究人员已经构建了一种原型计算机病毒，该病毒利用开放权重的大型语言模型（LLM）和精心设计的框架，能够实现自我维持和自我复制。这种病毒被称为“自我维持和自我复制的AI病毒”，其核心在于利用LLM的能力来生成新的攻击载荷或变异，从而绕过传统安全措施。文章强调，这种病毒的出现标志着AI安全领域面临新的挑战，因为开放权重模型使得恶意行为者更容易获取和利用这些技术。

其次，文章讨论了关于AI发展节奏的争议。一些专家认为，AI的发展速度过快，可能导致社会无法适应，因此需要“调整AI发展节奏”，即通过政策、伦理规范或技术手段来减缓AI的部署速度。这一观点与当前关于AI监管的讨论相呼应，但文章并未提供具体的政策建议或技术方案。

最后，文章提到了人们对AI与创造力的困惑。随着AI在艺术、写作等创造性领域的表现越来越强，人们开始质疑AI是否真正具备创造力，或者只是模仿人类创造力的表面特征。文章指出，这种困惑反映了公众对AI能力的误解，以及AI技术发展带来的哲学和伦理问题。

需要注意的是，本文为通讯文章，内容较为概括，缺乏详细的技术细节和具体案例，因此信息完整性有限。
keyPointsZh: AI研究人员构建了利用开放权重LLM的自我复制病毒原型。
开放权重模型降低了恶意使用AI技术的门槛。
关于AI发展节奏的讨论涉及政策、伦理和技术手段。
公众对AI创造力的理解存在困惑。
items.impactZh: 对于读者和开发者而言，这一报道提醒我们关注AI安全的重要性，尤其是在开放权重模型日益普及的背景下。对于行业而言，自我复制AI病毒的出现可能促使安全社区开发新的防御机制，并推动政策制定者考虑更严格的AI监管。此外，关于AI发展节奏和创造力的讨论可能影响公众对AI的接受度和信任度。

items.titleOriginal: Cloudflare Workers 与 Containers 现已支持入站 TCP 连接和 gRPC
items.summaryOriginal: Cloudflare 在 Agents Week 期间推出 Workers 运行时新处理器 connect（socket），可直接接受 Spectrum 提供的入站 TCP 套接字，并支持将套接字转发至 Durable Objects 或 Containers，实现全双工通信。
items.author: Cloudflare Blog
items.importanceReasonZh: 该功能扩展了 Workers 的网络能力，使开发者能够处理自定义 TCP 协议和 gRPC 服务，对边缘计算和微服务架构有实际影响。
items.importanceReasonEn: This feature expands Workers' networking capabilities, enabling developers to handle custom TCP protocols and gRPC services, with practical impact on edge computing and microservices architectures.
items.titleZh: Cloudflare Workers 与 Containers 现已支持入站 TCP 连接和 gRPC
items.titleEn: Cloudflare Workers and Containers Now Support Inbound TCP Connections and gRPC
items.summaryZh: Cloudflare 在 Agents Week 期间推出 Workers 运行时新处理器 connect（socket），可直接接受 Spectrum 提供的入站 TCP 套接字，并支持将套接字转发至 Durable Objects 或 Containers，实现全双工通信。
items.summaryEn: During Agents Week, Cloudflare introduced a new connect() handler in the Workers runtime that directly accepts inbound TCP sockets from Spectrum, and supports forwarding sockets to Durable Objects or Containers for full-duplex communication.
items.detailZh: Cloudflare 在 Agents Week 期间宣布，Workers 运行时现在支持通过新的 connect() 处理器直接接受入站 TCP 套接字。该处理器由 Spectrum 提供支持，允许 Workers 处理自定义 TCP 协议，包括 gRPC。连接可以转发到 Durable Objects 或 Containers，实现全双工通信。此前，Workers 仅支持 HTTP 请求，开发者需要依赖第三方服务或 Cloudflare 的 Spectrum 功能来代理 TCP 流量，但无法在 Workers 内部直接处理。现在，开发者可以在 Workers 中直接处理 TCP 连接，从而构建更广泛的网络应用。
keyPointsZh: Workers 运行时新增 connect() 处理器，可直接接受入站 TCP 套接字。
支持将 TCP 套接字转发至 Durable Objects 或 Containers。
支持 gRPC 协议，实现全双工通信。
该功能由 Spectrum 提供支持，扩展了 Workers 的网络能力。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，现在可以在边缘直接处理自定义 TCP 协议和 gRPC 服务，无需额外代理或中间层。这简化了微服务架构，降低了延迟，并使得在 Workers 上构建实时通信应用成为可能。对于行业而言，Cloudflare 进一步巩固了其边缘计算平台的竞争力，为更多类型的应用提供了部署选项。

items.titleOriginal: Two teams solved the same quantum crypto problem using GPT-5.6 just three hours apart
items.summaryOriginal: Two research teams independently solved the same open quantum cryptography problem using OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, submitting their papers just three hours apart. "If someone mentions an open problem, the first thing is to see if GPT solves it," says one of the researchers. The case raises a question: what does "independent discovery" mean when everyone uses the same models? The article Two teams solved the same quantum crypto problem using GPT-5.6 just three hours apart appeared first on The Decoder .
items.author: Matthias Bastian
items.importanceReasonZh: 该事件展示了AI在科研中的实际应用，并引发了对科研独立性和AI辅助发现伦理的讨论，对科研社区具有重要启示。
items.importanceReasonEn: This event demonstrates the practical use of AI in research and raises important questions about research independence and ethics of AI-assisted discovery, with significant implications for the research community.

items.titleOriginal: condense-json 1.0
items.summaryOriginal: Release: condense-json 1.0 I'm trying to get braver at releasing 1.0 versions. This little library is a year and a half old now - I've applied some sensible and non-disruptive fixes and shipped the big 1.0 for it. Here's an example of what it can do, lifted from the README: { "foo" : { "bar" : { "string" : " This is a string with foxes in it " , "nested" : { "more" : [ " Here is a string " , " another with foxes in it too " ] } } } } Combine that with a replacements object: { "1" : " with foxes in it " } And condense_json(input_json, replacements) produces the following: { "foo" : { "bar" : { "string" : { "$r" : [ " This is a string " , { "$" : " 1 " }]}, "nested" : { "more" : [ " Here is a string " , { "$r" : [ " another " , { "$" : " 1 " }, " too " ]}] } } } } It scans for strings or substrings that are present in that replacements object and replaces those with a special {"$r": ...} syntax in the output. You can reverse the effect with uncondense_json(condensed, replacements) . The idea is to make it easier to store JSON that includes duplicated data from other related structures. I use it to save space in the SQLite logs generated by LLM - see PR #1586 for the latest iteration

items.titleOriginal: Learning Stateful Predictive Knowledge From Experience
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly learn from experience, they primarily rely on trajectory-level reflection to extract insights. Viewed through the lens of predictive knowledge, we argue that this approach operates on episodic hindsight rather than predictive foresight, yielding brittle, path-dependent heuristics. To address this, we propose Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL). SKL shifts the agent's focus from trajectory-level summarization to maintaining Stateful Knowledge: explicit, declarative predictive assessments anchored to state. We first demonstrate a motivating example showing how stateful knowledge provides granularity, enhances generalization, and enables knowledge bootstrapping. To further scale up the idea, we introduce two algorithms via self-distillation (SKL-SD) and reinforcement learning (SKL-RL), training agents to autonomously extract state-grounded predictive knowledge from experience and learn to leverage it for policy making. items.titleOriginal: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28640v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should generate consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images, resulting in sequences where visual tokens are interleaved with text tokens. Based on TokenSwap, we transform existing text-based benchmarks such as MMLU into image-interleaved counterparts, resulting in TokenSwap-Bench. Across 42 MLLMs, we observe a pervasive modality gap, with performance decreasing by 4.2% to 47.4% when moving from text-only to image-interleaved inputs, averaging 19.6% +/- 3.3% across models. Notably, we observe that reasoning models exhibit consistently smaller gaps, achieving an average gap of 10.1% compared to 25.5% for non-reasoning models. items.detailZh:
该论文提出了一种名为TokenSwap的方法，通过将文本概念替换为语义对齐的图像，构建图像与文本交错的多模态输入序列。基于此方法，作者将MMLU等文本基准转换为图像交错版本，形成TokenSwap-Bench。在42个多模态大语言模型上，他们观察到从纯文本输入切换到图像交错输入时，模型性能普遍下降，平均下降19.6%。这一现象表明多模态模型在跨模态语义等价输入下存在系统性不一致。

进一步分析发现，推理模型（如具有推理能力的模型）的模态差距显著小于非推理模型，平均差距分别为10.1%和25.5%。这表明推理能力可能有助于模型更好地处理跨模态信息。然而，仅通过提示策略或增加训练计算量并不能单独缩小这一差距，暗示需要更根本的改进。
keyPointsZh: TokenSwap方法通过替换文本概念为语义对齐图像，构建图像交错输入。
基于TokenSwap构建的TokenSwap-Bench将文本基准转换为多模态基准。
在42个MLLM上，模态差距平均为19.6%，性能下降4.2%至47.4%。
推理模型的模态差距（10.1%）显著小于非推理模型（25.5%）。
提示策略和扩展训练计算不能单独缩小模态差距。
items.impactZh: 该研究为多模态大语言模型的评估提供了新工具，揭示了模态差距的普遍性和严重性。对于开发者而言，需要关注模型在跨模态输入下的一致性，并考虑引入推理能力来减小差距。对于行业而言，该基准可用于指导模型选择和优化。

Our evaluation reveals two severe LLM vulnerabilities. First, a "Knowledge Bottleneck": despite memorizing formulas during pre-training, models demonstrate fragile pattern matching. items.impactZh: 该研究对金融领域使用LLM的从业者具有警示意义，表明模型在复杂财务推理上可能不可靠，需要谨慎使用。对开发者而言，提示工程（如提供公式）可能暂时提升性能，但模型缺乏鲁棒性。对行业而言，需要开发更稳健的评估基准和训练方法，以增强模型的结构推理能力。

items.titleOriginal: The Checking Problem: What must be true before AI ships in a regulated firm
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise AI programmes stall at a rate that is widely quoted and poorly explained. This paper measures the mechanism. Six document-heavy workflows of the kind performed daily in regulated financial services were run across four model families and three tool configurations, three times each, producing 5,093 scored output elements across 72 configurations. Each configuration was assessed twice: against a demonstration bar, being a single correct run on a single case, and against a production bar requiring sustained accuracy, reproducibility across repeats, verifiable attribution, and a confidence signal that carries information. 57 of 72 configurations cleared the demonstration bar and 32 cleared the production bar, a survival rate of 56.1%. The paper then computes the review burden each configuration imposes, estimated out of sample rather than with hindsight. A tool that states no confidence requires review of 100% of its output, because it offers a reviewer no basis for triage. items.detailZh:
该研究针对企业AI项目停滞率高的问题，通过实验测量了其机制。实验在受监管金融服务中选取了六个文档密集型工作流，使用四个模型家族和三种工具配置，每种配置运行三次，共产生5,093个评分输出元素，覆盖72种配置。每种配置分别针对演示标准（单案例单次正确运行）和生产标准（持续准确性、重复可复现性、可验证归因、信息量置信信号）进行评估。结果显示，72种配置中57种通过演示标准，但只有32种通过生产标准，存活率仅为56.1%，表明演示成功并不等于生产可用。

文章进一步计算了每种配置的审查负担，采用样本外估计而非事后估计。研究发现，不提供置信度的工具需要审查100%的输出，因为审查者无法进行分流。而要求工具引用来源并给出置信度，可将审查负担降至49%，同时在20种配置中保持17种的残余错误容忍度。这表明，通过设计上的改进，可以显著降低人工审查成本，同时保持质量。

items.impactZh: 对于企业而言，该研究强调了在部署AI前必须满足生产标准，包括持续准确性、可复现性、可验证归因和置信度信号。开发者应注重设计可解释性和置信度输出，以降低审查成本。对于行业而言，该研究提供了量化审查负担的方法，有助于制定更合理的AI部署规范。
actionStepsZh: 在部署AI前，应使用生产标准（而非演示标准）进行评估，包括重复运行测试和归因验证。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entity linking in tables matches short and ambiguous cell mentions to their corresponding knowledge-base entities. Existing approaches typically rely on data preprocessing pipelines that retain either compact or extensive table content as contextual evidence, and then formulate entity linking as a language generation task for instruction-tuned models; recent systems further incorporate explicit reasoning to disambiguate challenging mentions. However, their training supervision is usually static: fixed preference data cannot adapt to the residual errors of an evolving model, while variations in reasoning length can bias sequence-level preference learning. To address these limitations, we present TELLER: Table Entity Linking through Learning from Errors and Reasoning. We first retrieve and rank Wikidata candidates and retain reduced table evidence in the prompt. The direct-answer path applies iterative direct preference optimization and refreshes its preference data with residual errors from the updated model. items.detailZh:
该论文介绍了一种名为TELLER的新方法，用于表格实体链接任务。表格实体链接旨在将表格中的单元格提及与知识库中的实体进行匹配，这是一个具有挑战性的任务，因为提及通常简短且模糊。现有方法通常依赖于数据预处理流程，保留紧凑或广泛的表格内容作为上下文证据，然后将实体链接视为语言生成任务。然而，这些方法的训练监督通常是静态的，无法适应模型的持续改进，并且推理长度的变化可能会影响序列级偏好学习。

TELLER方法通过两个路径来解决这些问题：直接答案路径和推理路径。在直接答案路径中，使用迭代直接偏好优化（iterative DPO）来训练模型，并不断用更新模型的残余错误刷新偏好数据。在推理路径中，使用过滤和压缩的思维链理由进行监督微调，然后进行迭代优化。该方法首先检索并排序Wikidata候选，并在提示中保留缩减的表格证据。

论文的摘要部分被截断，但可以推断出TELLER在表格实体链接任务上取得了显著的性能提升。该研究为表格实体链接提供了一种新的训练范式，可能对相关领域的研究产生重要影响。
keyPointsZh: TELLER是一种用于表格实体链接的新方法，结合了迭代直接偏好优化和推理路径。
直接答案路径使用迭代DPO，并动态更新偏好数据以反映模型的残余错误。
推理路径使用过滤和压缩的思维链理由进行监督微调。
方法首先检索并排序Wikidata候选，并保留缩减的表格证据。
该方法旨在解决静态偏好数据和推理长度偏差的问题。
items.impactZh: 该研究对表格实体链接领域具有重要影响。它提出了一种新的训练范式，能够动态适应模型的改进，并利用推理路径提高消歧能力。这可能推动相关应用的发展，如知识库构建、数据集成和语义搜索。对于开发者和研究人员，该方法提供了一种可复现的训练流程，可能提高实体链接的准确性和鲁棒性。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The estimation of item difficulty plays a key role in both formative assessment and large-scale high-stakes summative assessments. This study explores how large language models (LLMs) perform in predicting item difficulty levels using items from a large-scale Reading and Writing test. The study investigated various prompting strategies and parameter settings across multiple LLMs. LLM performance was compared with encoder-only language models and feature-based supervised machine learning models. items.titleOriginal: Imbalanced Data Clustering via Targeted Data Augmentation Using GMM and LLM
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Natural Language Processing (NLP), dealing with underrepresented topics is challenging, especially in unsupervised tasks where clustering might not adequately capture minority topics. To tackle this challenge, our paper presents a novel unsupervised data augmentation method that integrates Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs). Due to their flexibility and robustness, GMMs can detect clusters corresponding to underrepresented areas in the data, while LLMs create synthetic documents to enrich these clusters and improve their representation. Experiments on various imbalanced text datasets demonstrate that our approach preserves clustering performance in all cases and often enhances cluster interpretability, offering a robust and scalable solution for improving data representation in unsupervised NLP tasks.

items.titleOriginal: Chain-of-Models: Cross-Model Auditing for Bias-Robust LLM Judges
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28636v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs increasingly serve as automated judges, but their judgments remain vulnerable to cognitive biases. Existing mitigations mostly rely on prompt-driven debiasing, which is brittle across bias types, or human evaluation, which does not scale. We study \emph{Chain-of-Models} (CoM), an automated audit pipeline in which a second model inspects the first model's reasoning trace before producing the final judgment. The key design question is whether the auditor should be the same model, a same-family model, or a different-family model. Across 9 models from 6 families, 4 cognitive biases, and 4 factual datasets, we find that auditor identity matters in two ways. First, standalone bias resistance does not predict audit effectiveness: Kimi-K2.5 is the strongest standalone model on several biases, yet is a weak auditor for Qwen2.5-72B's biased traces. Second, the best auditor is bias-specific: GPT-4o is strongest on bandwagon, authority, and distraction, while GLM-5 is strongest on sycophancy. items.titleOriginal: ZeroR@CHiPSAL 2026: Two-Stage Vision-Language Adaptation with Contrastive Learning for Nepali Meme Classification
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents our system for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task on multimodal hate speech and sentiment detection in Nepali memes. We address both subtasks: binary hate speech classification and three-class sentiment analysis. Our approach adapts the Robust Adaptation of Hateful Meme Detection (RA-HMD) framework using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, a state-of-the-art vision-language model with native Devanagari support. We employ a two-stage training pipeline: (1) LoRA fine-tuning with an MLP projection head for generative classification, and (2) contrastive backbone fine-tuning with supervised InfoNCE loss. We handle class imbalance through minority oversampling, image augmentation, and focal loss. At inference, we ensemble Stage 1 token probabilities with Stage 2 classifier scores using validation-tuned weights. Our end-to-end approach eliminates error propagation from separate OCR and translation pipelines by leveraging the model's native Devanagari understanding. items.titleOriginal: DragonCrawl: A Generative, Intent-Based Framework for Scalable Mobile End-to-End Testing
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28750v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As mobile applications grow in complexity, traditional End-to-End (E2E) testing frameworks struggle with UI volatility, maintenance overhead, and cross-platform scalability. This paper presents DragonCrawl, an AI-driven mobile testing system for continuous regression testing that has evolved from embedding-based similarity matching to generative intent-based reasoning using large language models. Unlike prior LLM-based testing research focused on exploratory testing and crash detection, DragonCrawl validates specific user flows on every code change, blocking commits that break critical functionality. By leveraging GPT-4o's multimodal capabilities, DragonCrawl achieves 91.6% pass rate on iOS and 92.2% on Android across 1,013 automated tests running continuously in CI/CD pipelines. The system reduces test onboarding time from 96-120 hours to under 4 hours and has saved an estimated 27 developer years in test maintenance effort. items.titleOriginal: WaiT for the Signal: Simple Frequency-Aware Flow-Matching
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As image generation models scale to ever higher resolutions, global coherence, local detail, and texture fidelity become critical axes for generation quality. However, standard flow matching treats all spatial frequencies uniformly, ignoring the natural frequency hierarchy where high-frequency bands become indistinguishable from pure noise far earlier than coarse structures. We introduce WaiT, a Wavelet-aware image Transformer that decomposes generation into coarse and fine bands via lossless wavelets. True to its name, the high-frequency bands wait for the signal: staying pure noise until coarse structure has emerged, then joining the flow for joint refinement. Since standard FID discards fine-grained detail through aggressive downsampling, we introduce a more stringent three-axis evaluation protocol to assess quality at native resolution. On ImageNet 512x512, WaiT achieves a pixel-space FID of 1.43 and is Pareto-optimal across all three axes, reducing sampling compute by up to 50%. items.titleOriginal: Stratified Negation in RDF Rules: A Correct Approach (Extended Version)
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28778v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Combining RDF rule languages, such as N3 or SHACL Rules, with default negation is challenging. Existing methods to stratify negation often fail for RDF rules, since individual triples do not carry enough information to meaningfully restrict potential dependencies. Blank nodes in rule heads further complicate the matter, since the order of rule applications may determine whether new values are created, which in turn can change the applicability of rules with negation. To solve these open problems, we propose chain stratification as a robust new condition that guarantees a well-behaved semantics for RDF rules with negation, and existential rules in general. Our condition combines an elaborate analysis of potential multistep derivations with a mechanism for using integrity constraints to discard impossible cases. Applying rules in any order that respects chain stratification is guaranteed to derive an RDF graph that is unique, lean, and justified under the usual negation-as-failure semantics. To show the practicality, we also provide a prototype implementation.
items.author: Nils K\"uchenmeister, Alex Ivliev, D\"orthe Arndt, Markus Kr\"otzsch

items.titleOriginal: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Benchmark datasets are central to evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), yet they are typically conceived as monolithic tasks, obscuring substantial variation in the demands of individual samples. We introduce a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets at the sample level along five latent dimensions: 1. Cognitive and Knowledge Demands, 2. Language and Content Quality, 3. Task Properties, 4. Context, and 5. Ethics, Safety, and Fairness. Applying this framework, we annotate five influential benchmarks -- MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, and TruthfulQA -- revealing pronounced internal heterogeneity that is not captured by aggregate accuracy scores. We show how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite benchmark subsets across datasets, supporting targeted evaluation of model capabilities such as Reasoning Depth or Ethical Sensitivity. This approach reframes benchmark evaluation as dataset introspection, providing a principled methodology for analyzing and re-composing existing benchmarks to better reflect diverse evaluation needs.
items.author: Philipp D. Siedler, Jordan Sassoon
items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究提出了一种新颖的基准测试审计方法，有助于更细致地理解模型能力，对评估实践有潜在影响，但尚未经过广泛验证。

The authors annotate five benchmarks (MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA), revealing internal heterogeneity not captured by aggregate accuracy, and demonstrate how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite subsets across datasets for targeted evaluation of capabilities like reasoning depth or ethical sensitivity.
items.detailZh:
该论文指出，基准数据集通常被视为单一任务，掩盖了单个样本需求的显著差异。为此，作者提出了一个以数据集为中心的元评估框架，在样本级别对基准进行审计，涵盖五个潜在维度：认知与知识需求、语言与内容质量、任务属性、上下文以及伦理、安全与公平性。他们将该框架应用于五个有影响力的基准（MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA），并进行了标注，揭示了这些基准内部存在显著的异质性，而这种异质性无法通过聚合准确率分数体现。

基于这些标注，作者展示了如何实现跨数据集的组合子集编排，以支持针对特定模型能力（如推理深度或伦理敏感性）的定向评估。这种方法将基准评估重新定义为数据集内省，为分析和重新组合现有基准以更好地反映多样化评估需求提供了原则性方法论。

该研究来自arXiv预印本，属于交叉领域，可能对评估方法论和基准设计有参考价值。然而，由于是预印本，尚未经过同行评审，其框架的有效性和实用性有待进一步验证。

对MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA进行标注，揭示内部异质性。
展示如何利用标注进行跨数据集编排，实现定向评估。

items.titleOriginal: Rolling With Resistance: Preference-Optimized LLM Counselors Can Trade Goal Persistence for Relational Attunement in Motivational Interviewing
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28814v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In Motivational Interviewing (MI), a client's sustain talk (arguments for the status quo) calls for the counselor to roll with resistance, a move that can fail in two opposite ways: capitulation (abandoning the change agenda to preserve rapport) or confrontation (arguing or directing, overriding the client's autonomy). We introduce a two-axis evaluation of counselor responses, anchored in the Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI) code, Goal Persistence (GP) and Relational Attunement (RA), yielding a four-quadrant framing in which rolling with resistance is high on both, and we ask whether penalizing one failure through preference optimization teaches rolling with resistance or provokes its opposite. From the expert-annotated AnnoMI corpus we build topic-disjoint Direct Preference Optimization data whose preference sets differ only in which failure is rejected, using on-policy negatives. An automatic judge, validated against AnnoMI's expert labels and rechecked by trained human coders, scores blind pairwise win-rates against each base under a firewall in which disjoint model families generate, label, and judge. items.titleZh: 与阻力共舞：偏好优化的LLM咨询师在动机性访谈中可权衡目标坚持与关系调谐
items.titleEn: Rolling With Resistance: Preference-Optimized LLM Counselors Can Trade Goal Persistence for Relational Attunement in Motivational Interviewing
items.summaryZh: 在动机性访谈中，来访者的维持性谈话（为现状辩护）要求咨询师“与阻力共舞”，这一动作可能以两种相反方式失败：屈服（放弃改变议程以维持关系）或对抗（争辩或指导，侵犯来访者自主性）。我们引入基于MITI编码的双轴评估：目标坚持（GP）和关系调谐（RA），形成四象限框架，其中“与阻力共舞”在两者上均高。我们询问通过偏好优化惩罚一种失败，是教会模型“与阻力共舞”还是引发其反面。从专家标注的AnnoMI语料库构建主题不相交的DPO数据，其偏好集仅在被拒绝的失败类型上不同，使用on-policy负样本。自动评判器（经AnnoMI专家标签验证并由训练有素的人类编码员复核）在防火墙下对每个基础模型进行盲法成对胜率评分，其中不相交的模型家族负责生成、标注和评判。
items.summaryEn: In Motivational Interviewing (MI), a client's sustain talk calls for the counselor to roll with resistance, a move that can fail in two opposite ways: capitulation or confrontation. We introduce a two-axis evaluation of counselor responses, anchored in the MITI code, Goal Persistence (GP) and Relational Attunement (RA), yielding a four-quadrant framing. We ask whether penalizing one failure through preference optimization teaches rolling with resistance or provokes its opposite. From the AnnoMI corpus we build topic-disjoint DPO data with on-policy negatives. An automatic judge, validated against expert labels and rechecked by human coders, scores blind pairwise win-rates under a firewall with disjoint model families.
items.detailZh: 该研究关注动机性访谈中咨询师对来访者维持性谈话的回应。在MI中，当来访者表达维持现状的理由时，咨询师应“与阻力共舞”，即既保持目标坚持（推动改变）又保持关系调谐（尊重自主性）。然而，模型可能倾向于两种失败模式：屈服（完全放弃改变目标）或对抗（强行说服）。研究者提出用双轴评估（GP和RA）来刻画回应质量，并探讨通过偏好优化（DPO）惩罚一种失败是否会导致另一种失败。他们从AnnoMI语料库构建了主题不相交的DPO数据，使用on-policy负样本，并采用自动评判器（经专家验证）进行盲法评估。实验在防火墙设计下进行，确保生成、标注和评判的模型家族不相交，以避免偏差。
keyPointsZh: 提出双轴评估框架（GP和RA）用于动机性访谈中的咨询师回应。
使用DPO偏好优化，偏好集仅在被拒绝的失败类型上不同。
自动评判器经AnnoMI专家标签验证，并由人类编码员复核。
采用防火墙设计，模型家族不相交以增强评估可靠性。
items.impactZh: 该研究为LLM在心理咨询等敏感领域的对齐提供了新视角，强调在目标坚持和关系调谐之间取得平衡。对开发者而言，提示了偏好优化可能带来的副作用，需要谨慎设计奖励函数。对行业而言，有助于开发更符合伦理的AI咨询工具。

items.titleOriginal: Hypergradient-based Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Improved Sample Complexity
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28849v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) is an important framework within the literature of RL that can be used to formalize various categories of problems, such as meta-learning, hierarchical task decomposition, and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RL-HF). Most of the bilevel RL algorithms are either not scalable because of using hypergradient with Hessian, or they suffer from high sample complexity because of using penalty-based approximation methods. In this work, we propose a hypergradient-based bilevel RL algorithm using the optimality of the Boltzmann policy for the entropy regularized discounted RL objective function. Our proposed algorithm is Hessian-free and obtains an iteration complexity of $O(\epsilon^{-1})$ and state-of-the-art sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ under mild regularity conditions. Further, in our convergence analysis, we are able to remove the assumption of the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition on the outer-level objective function present in the prior state-of-the-art sample complexity work.
items.author: Naman Saxena, Mudit Gaur, Vaneet Aggarwal

items.titleOriginal: A Unified Benchmark of Deep Learning Models for Multi-task 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28858v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has become a fundamental task in computer-assisted diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. Although numerous deep learning architectures have recently been proposed, objective comparisons remain challenging because published studies often employ different datasets, preprocessing strategies, training protocols, and evaluation procedures. This work presents a unified experimental benchmark for comparing representative convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Transformer-based models, and recent State Space Model (SSM) architectures under homogeneous experimental conditions. Five state-of-the-art three-dimensional segmentation models, including 3D U-Net, SegResNet, Swin UNETR, SegMamba, and SegMambaV2, are evaluated on two brain tumor segmentation datasets representing distinct clinical scenarios: intracranial meningioma segmentation (BraTS 2023) and post-treatment glioma segmentation (BraTS 2024). items.titleOriginal: TextCloak: Thwarting Unauthorized LLM Exploitation via RL-Driven Unlearnable Text
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28862v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to significant advances across a wide range of language tasks, while simultaneously raising growing concerns about unauthorized data exploitation and privacy leakage. Unlearnable examples (UEs) offer a promising defense by introducing carefully designed perturbations into data such that models trained on them exhibit degraded utility. However, existing methods for text protection are primarily designed for classification tasks (e.g., sentiment analysis) in discriminative language models and often rely on injecting class-specific linguistic cues, which limits their effectiveness in the open-ended generation settings of LLMs. In this work, we propose TextCloak, an RL-driven framework for protecting textual data against unauthorized LLM exploitation. TextCloak employs a generative policy that transforms batches of clean text into unlearnable examples while preserving semantic fidelity and linguistic naturalness. items.titleOriginal: Validation Evidence in LLM Repair Agents: How Much of What Passes Actually Tests the Bug?
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28871v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a repair agent runs a test and sees it pass, the result is treated as evidence about the reported defect. We measure how often that treatment is warranted. BSG-VA (buggy-state/candidate-state/gold-fix validation analysis) captures each validation command at its exact working-tree state, extracts a test-only patch, and replays the command on the original buggy code (B), the candidate state (S), and the developer gold fix (G). The captured outcome and the replay results assign every event an evidence role, from gold-aligned bug-discriminating through regression-only to misleading. Across 3,730 events in 643 rollouts on 110 tasks, 46.0% of positive comparable events carry no bug-discriminating information; 23.8% of baseline rollouts, with no feedback injected, close with a patch whose entire positive evidence base is of this kind. A three-arm experiment tests whether returning the B-replay outcome to the agent changes this pattern. Bug-contrast feedback reduces evidence-inadequate closure by 7.8 percentage points relative to an attention-matched reminder (p = 0.0029) and raises bug-discriminating evidence by 7.4 points (p = 0.011)

items.summaryZh: arXiv:2607.28871v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：当修复代理运行测试并看到通过时，结果被视为关于所报告缺陷的证据。我们衡量这种处理在多大程度上是合理的。BSG-VA（缺陷状态/候选状态/黄金修复验证分析）在精确的工作树状态下捕获每个验证命令，提取仅测试补丁，并在原始缺陷代码（B）、候选状态（S）和开发者黄金修复（G）上重放命令。捕获的结果和重放结果将每个事件分配一个证据角色，从黄金对齐的缺陷区分到仅回归再到误导。在110个任务的643次运行中的3,730个事件中，46.0%的正向可比事件不携带缺陷区分信息；23.8%的基线运行（无反馈注入）以整个正向证据基础为此类的补丁结束。一项三臂实验测试将B重放结果返回给代理是否会改变这种模式。缺陷对比反馈相对于注意力匹配提醒将证据不足的闭合减少了7.8个百分点（p = 0.0029），并将缺陷区分证据提高了7.4个百分点（p = 0.011）。

The captured outcome and the replay results assign every event an evidence role, from gold-aligned bug-discriminating through regression-only to misleading. items.detailZh:
该研究由arXiv预印本发布，编号2607.28871，属于人工智能领域。研究关注LLM修复代理在运行测试并通过时，将结果视为缺陷证据的合理性。作者提出了BSG-VA（缺陷状态/候选状态/黄金修复验证分析）方法，在精确的工作树状态下捕获每个验证命令，提取仅测试补丁，并在原始缺陷代码（B）、候选状态（S）和开发者黄金修复（G）上重放命令。通过捕获的结果和重放结果，将每个事件分配一个证据角色，从黄金对齐的缺陷区分到仅回归再到误导。

实验在110个任务的643次运行中收集了3,730个事件。结果显示，46.0%的正向可比事件不携带缺陷区分信息；23.8%的基线运行（无反馈注入）以整个正向证据基础为此类的补丁结束。这表明大量通过的测试并未真正针对缺陷，可能误导修复代理。

为了改善这一情况，研究进行了三臂实验，测试将B重放结果返回给代理是否改变模式。结果表明，缺陷对比反馈相对于注意力匹配提醒将证据不足的闭合减少了7.8个百分点（p = 0.0029），并将缺陷区分证据提高了7.4个百分点（p = 0.011）。这提示提供缺陷对比反馈可以显著提升修复代理的证据质量。
keyPointsZh: BSG-VA方法在精确工作树状态下捕获验证命令，并在B、S、G上重放以评估证据角色。
在3,730个事件中，46.0%的正向可比事件不携带缺陷区分信息。
23.8%的基线运行以整个正向证据基础为证据不足的补丁结束。
缺陷对比反馈将证据不足的闭合减少了7.8个百分点，并将缺陷区分证据提高了7.4个百分点。
items.impactZh: 该研究对LLM修复代理的开发者和使用者有重要影响。它揭示了依赖测试通过作为缺陷证据的潜在风险，可能导致修复不完整或错误。通过引入缺陷对比反馈，可以显著提高修复代理的证据质量，从而提升修复的准确性和可靠性。对于构建更可靠的自动修复系统具有指导意义。

items.titleOriginal: RareSense: Rarity-Aware Similarity Search for Anomaly Retrieval in Transactional Data
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28879v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Similarity search over sparse set-valued data is often dominated by frequent background attributes because classical measures such as Jaccard, cosine, and Hamming compare objects through atomic overlap. IDF (Inverse document frequency) weighting partially reduces this effect but remains atom-wise and cannot explicitly represent informative higher-order co-occurrences. We introduce RareSense, a rarity-aware similarity framework for sparse transactional anomaly data. RareSense mines minimal rare itemsets as intermediate structures, derives reliable rare association rules, maps objects into sparse rare-rule profiles, and compares them using weighted Jaccard similarity. Rule weights combine inverse support, confidence, lift, structural complexity, and stability, so that neighborhoods are determined by shared rare evidence rather than uniform feature overlap. We show that IDF-weighted Jaccard is a restricted singleton case of RareSense, and that the induced distance is a pseudometric on the original objects and a metric over equivalence classes defined by identical rule profiles. items.titleOriginal: To Add Is Machine, To Delete Is Human: Measuring and Mitigating Deletion Avoidance in LLM Code Editing
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28887v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models increasingly write and repair production code, yet evidence is mounting that their test-passing patches leave codebases harder to maintain. We identify one concrete source: deletion avoidance, the systematic tendency to retain code that an intended edit requires removing. Across the five leading models on the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard, deletion recall against the developer patch reaches at most 71.7% even on tasks all five solve, and models reach the right file for over 92% of required deletions but cut the exact line in under 52% of cases. Instead, 29.0% of passing patches wrap the targeted code in a guard or fallback, a pattern we call Guard-and-Go. Such patches pass because the original tests rarely check removal: when we retrofit 34 Verified tasks with tests that fail if the targeted code remains, four frontier models spanning closed and open weights fall from 63.2% to 41.9%. Because real repairs mix removal with addition, we curate CanItDelete, a benchmark of 200 tasks mined from real commits whose entire required edit is deletion. Even with the addition work gone, the best model still fails
items.author: Amir M. Ebrahimi, Mohammed Mehedi Hasan, Aaditya Bhatia, Gopi Krishnan Rajbahadur, Ahmed E. Hassan
items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究揭示了一个重要且被忽视的问题：LLM在代码编辑中倾向于避免删除代码，导致补丁通过测试但增加维护负担。提供了量化证据和基准，对代码生成领域有重要影响。
items.importanceReasonEn: This research reveals an important and overlooked issue: LLMs tend to avoid deleting code in edits, leading to patches that pass tests but increase maintenance burden. It provides quantitative evidence and a benchmark, with significant implications for code generation.
items.titleZh: 添加是机器，删除是人类：测量并缓解LLM代码编辑中的删除回避
items.titleEn: To Add Is Machine, To Delete Is Human: Measuring and Mitigating Deletion Avoidance in LLM Code Editing

items.detailZh: 该论文指出，大型语言模型在代码编辑任务中表现出“删除回避”倾向，即系统性地保留本应删除的代码。在SWE-bench Verified排行榜上的五个领先模型上，删除召回率最高仅为71.7%，即使所有模型都解决了任务。模型在超过92%的必需删除中定位到了正确的文件，但在不到52%的情况下精确删除了目标行。相反，29.0%的通过补丁采用了“守卫并继续”模式，即用条件语句包裹目标代码而不是删除它。这种补丁能通过原始测试，因为测试很少检查代码是否被删除。当研究人员为34个任务添加了针对删除的测试后，四个前沿模型的通过率从63.2%下降到41.9%。为了进一步研究，他们构建了CanItDelete基准，包含200个从真实提交中挖掘的、仅需删除操作的任务。即使在这些纯删除任务中，最佳模型的表现仍然不佳，表明删除回避是系统性的问题。
keyPointsZh: LLM在代码编辑中表现出删除回避，删除召回率最高仅71.7%。
29.0%的通过补丁采用守卫或回退模式而非删除代码。
添加针对删除的测试后，模型通过率从63.2%降至41.9%。
构建了CanItDelete基准，包含200个纯删除任务，模型表现不佳。
items.impactZh: 该研究对依赖LLM进行代码修复的开发者有直接影响：即使补丁通过测试，也可能留下冗余代码，增加维护成本。对AI代码生成领域而言，需要改进训练目标和评估方法，以鼓励模型正确执行删除操作。

items.titleOriginal: Human-LLM Collaborative Inductive Coding for Conceptualizing K-12 Educator AI Use
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28889v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Qualitative researchers increasingly encounter interaction corpora whose scale exceeds what manual coding alone can address, and large language models (LLMs) are frequently proposed as analytic assistants. The open questions are not whether LLMs can participate in qualitative analysis but to what extent, in what phases, and under what safeguards. This article provides a detailed procedural account of a multi-phase human-LLM collaborative pipeline that adapted open, axial, and selective coding to develop a hierarchical codebook from 45,000 messages exchanged between K-12 educators and a generative AI platform. Across three phases, LLMs generated candidate labels and structured annotations at scale, while human researchers retained conceptual authority over category definitions, merging decisions, and interpretive frameworks. items.detailZh:
该研究针对定性研究者面临的大规模交互语料（如45,000条消息）超出人工编码能力的问题，提出了一种多阶段人机协作流水线。该方法改编了传统的开放编码、轴向编码和选择性编码，利用LLM生成候选标签和结构化注释，同时人类研究者保留对类别定义、合并决策和解释框架的最终控制权。具体流程分为三个阶段：第一阶段，LLM辅助进行开放编码，生成初步标签；第二阶段，人类研究者与LLM协作进行轴向编码，整合和细化类别；第三阶段，进行选择性编码，形成层次化编码本。

为了验证编码本的可靠性，研究者让三名具有教育领域专业知识的编码员将其应用于独立的2,560条消息样本，并使用适用于多标签编码的集合值一致性度量进行迭代校准。结果表明，该编码本在人类编码员之间达到了可接受的可靠性。该研究详细记录了每个阶段的步骤、决策和挑战，为其他研究者提供了可复制的流程。
keyPointsZh: 提出了一种多阶段人机协作编码流水线，结合LLM的规模化处理与人类的概念权威。
从45,000条K-12教育者与AI平台的交互消息中开发出层次化编码本。
通过三名训练有素的编码员对2,560条消息的独立样本进行测试，并采用集合值一致性度量建立可靠性。
详细记录了流程步骤，为定性研究者提供了可复制的参考。
items.impactZh: 该研究为定性研究者提供了一种处理大规模交互语料的实用方法，通过人机协作提高编码效率，同时保持人类对概念框架的控制。对AI辅助定性分析领域具有方法论贡献，可能推动更多研究者采用LLM作为分析助手。

items.titleOriginal: Agreement Is Not Quality: Blind Expert Verification of Human and LLM Qualitative Coding When Human Consensus Is Not Ground Truth
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28890v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Evaluations of LLM-assisted qualitative coding almost universally measure model performance as agreement with human coders, a practice that presumes human coding is the standard to approximate. This study provides empirical evidence that the presumption fails in ways agreement metrics cannot detect. Five LLM systems and three trained human coders independently applied a 72-item hierarchical codebook to 2,560 educator messages from a K-12 AI platform. Beyond conventional agreement analysis, an independent domain expert judged 855 pairwise comparisons of code sets blind to source, treating human and machine sources symmetrically. The two evaluation approaches diverge in both directions. Human-LLM agreement (mean Jaccard 0.30) falls well below human-human agreement (0.52), which standard practice would read as inferior LLM coding, yet the blind verifier preferred human and LLM coding at indistinguishable rates (51.5% vs. 48.5%, p = 0.537), and a Bradley-Terry ranking placed two LLMs above two of three human coders. items.titleOriginal: TORUS: A Test of Rendering-Understanding Self-Coherence for Unified Audio Models
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28896v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Unified audio models capable of audio understanding, audio generation and, increasingly, audio editing are proliferating rapidly. Yet a basic question about them remains unanswered: do the two heads of a unified model agree about the same audio? Current practice evaluates each capability in isolation on specialized benchmarks, and never asks whether a model can make sense of its own generations. We present TORUS, the first self-coherence test for audio-native unified models. TORUS comprises 48 three-stage self-coherence tests carrying 432 six-option questions spanning speech, sound and music across five task families. We holistically evaluate five open unified models alongside a Cascaded Baseline that combines state-of-the-art specialized generation, editing and understanding models. The best unified model answers 50.5% of questions against the Cascaded Baseline's 63.2% and a 16.7% chance floor. Models struggle on audio editing. Among the evaluated audio models (specialized and unified), we observe limited self-coherence, and thus position self-coherence as an essential test for future audio systems.

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28916v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multistep credit assignment is critical for sample-efficient reinforcement learning, yet managing off-policy bias in Q-learning remains a fundamental challenge. For 30 years, practitioners have been limited to a binary choice: eliminate the bias at the cost of severely truncated eligibility traces (Watkins' Q($\lambda$)), or ignore the bias to learn faster while injecting detrimental errors into the value estimates (Peng's Q($\lambda$)). Modern off-policy estimators fail to resolve this tension, as importance-sampling ratios collapse under Q-learning's greedy target policy. We introduce Gated Q-learning, a novel algorithmic framework that ends this dilemma by smoothly interpolating between the two historical extremes. items.detailZh:
该论文介绍了一种名为门控Q学习（Gated Q-learning）的新算法框架，旨在解决强化学习中多步信用分配与离策略偏差之间的根本性挑战。传统上，Q学习算法在管理离策略偏差时面临两难选择：Watkins的Q(λ)通过严重截断资格迹来消除偏差，但牺牲了学习速度；而Peng的Q(λ)则忽略偏差以加快学习，但会向价值估计中注入有害误差。现代离策略估计器（如重要性采样）在Q学习的贪婪目标策略下失效，因为重要性采样比率会崩溃。

门控Q学习通过引入一种连续的、状态-动作相关的门控机制，以探索感知的方式选择性地衰减资格迹，从而在两种极端之间平滑插值。该方法不依赖重要性采样，而是通过门控机制动态调整资格迹的衰减，从而在控制偏差的同时保持学习效率。论文提供了严格的理论基础，证明了期望算子仍然是收缩映射，并推导出其精确的不动点。

实证评估验证了中间门控设置能够安全地平衡偏差与方差，表明该方法在多种任务上具有竞争力。然而，摘要中未提供具体的实验细节或性能对比，因此其实际效果仍需进一步验证。
keyPointsZh: 门控Q学习提出了一种新的算法框架，通过门控机制在Watkins和Peng的Q(λ)之间平滑插值。
该方法不依赖重要性采样，而是采用状态-动作相关的连续门控来衰减资格迹。
论文证明了期望算子的收缩性，并推导了精确的不动点。

items.impactZh: 该研究可能为强化学习中的信用分配问题提供新的解决思路，使从业者能够更灵活地控制离策略偏差，从而在样本效率和最终性能之间取得更好的平衡。对于开发者和研究人员，门控Q学习可能成为一种新的算法选择，尤其是在需要多步信用分配的场景中。然而，由于摘要信息有限，其实际效果和适用性仍需通过完整论文和复现实验来评估。

This disagreement may arise from differences in audit format. items.detailZh:
大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于分配稀缺资源，例如财务援助、医疗资源等，这引发了关于基于种族、性别等特征的偏见分配的担忧。然而，现有的LLM审计研究结果并不一致，有些研究发现模型对女性和少数族裔存在正面歧视，而另一些则发现负面歧视，即使对相同的模型也是如此。这种不一致性可能源于审计设计的不同，例如评估任务（评分、排名或分配）、比较背景（单一刺激或多刺激）以及审计是透明的还是伪装的。

为了解决这个问题，研究者引入了FairFund-Bench基准，该系统性地变化了先前审计设计的关键特征。该基准包含600个财务援助请求，这些请求由人类编写的模板生成，并根据130万个真实GoFundMe活动进行了校准。请求涵盖三个领域（如医疗、教育、社区）、四个种族类别和两个性别类别，以及五种基于福利应得理论的因果框架（如努力、责任、身份等）。

研究在14个LLM上进行了实验，结果显示审计格式确实改变了偏见的方向。例如，当模型单独评分每个申请人时，它们倾向于有利于少数族裔，但在排名或分配任务中，某些群体可能会受到惩罚。这表明审计结果对格式高度敏感，因此需要更标准化的审计方法。

该研究强调了在评估LLM公平性时考虑审计设计的重要性，并为未来的审计提供了基准工具。
keyPointsZh: FairFund-Bench是一个新基准，用于评估LLM在资源分配中的偏见，包含600个财务援助请求。
基准系统性地变化审计格式，包括评估任务、比较背景和透明度。
在14个LLM上，审计格式改变了偏见的方向：单独评分时有利于少数族裔，但排名时可能惩罚某些群体。
研究结果解释了先前审计结果不一致的原因，并强调了标准化审计设计的重要性。
items.impactZh: 对于AI开发者和研究者，该基准提供了一种更全面的方法来评估LLM在资源分配中的公平性，有助于识别和缓解偏见。对于政策制定者，它强调了审计设计对结果的影响，提示在制定AI审计标准时需要考虑格式因素。对于社会，它有助于提高对LLM在关键决策中潜在偏见的认识。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated pre-training offers a way to train foundation models on private or distributed data without centralizing the underlying datasets. However, evaluating federated pre-training remains challenging because differences in client participation and local data availability can make directly comparable evaluation difficult. Moreover, pre-training test perplexity is tied to the pre-training distribution, while downstream benchmarks introduce task-specific adaptation that may not faithfully reflect the test perplexity established during pre-training. items.titleOriginal: Sensitivity Analysis of GRU, LSTM and Transformer Encoder in Classification of Automated Driving Systems
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28665v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated driving systems (ADSs) are becoming ubiquitous. Future Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs) may be able to run multiple ADSs, both native and aftermarket such as Comma.ai's Openpilot. Monitoring systems to independently verify which automated driving system is active are important for safety monitoring, regulatory compliance, insurance assessment, and anomaly detection. In this paper, we first evaluate the effectiveness of three sequence-based classification models: Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and a Transformer encoder model for identifying Level 2 automated driving systems using vehicle telematics data alone: Comma Openpilot, Tesla Autopilot, and Cadillac Super Cruise, along with manual driving. items.author: Bidhya Shrestha, Christos Papadopoulos

items.titleZh: GRU、LSTM和Transformer编码器在自动驾驶系统分类中的敏感性分析
items.titleEn: Sensitivity Analysis of GRU, LSTM and Transformer Encoder in Classification of Automated Driving Systems
items.summaryZh: 本文评估了三种序列分类模型（GRU、LSTM和Transformer编码器）在仅使用车辆遥测数据识别Level 2自动驾驶系统（Comma Openpilot、Tesla Autopilot、Cadillac Super Cruise）和手动驾驶方面的有效性。在干净数据上，三种模型均取得较高的宏F1分数（GRU 0.92，LSTM 0.90，Transformer 0.93）；威胁匹配训练在轻微降低干净数据性能的情况下，宏F1达到0.904-0.916。此外，文章引入了一个模块化鲁棒性评估框架，通过五种损坏因素模拟现实遥测数据退化。
items.summaryEn: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of three sequence-based classification models (GRU, LSTM, and Transformer encoder) in identifying Level 2 automated driving systems (Comma Openpilot, Tesla Autopilot, Cadillac Super Cruise) and manual driving using vehicle telematics data alone. All three models achieve strong clean-data performance with macro F1-scores of 0.92 (GRU), 0.90 (LSTM), and 0.93 (Transformer encoder). Threat-matched training yields 0.904-0.916 macro F1 with only a modest clean-data penalty. Additionally, a modular robustness evaluation framework is introduced to simulate realistic telematics degradation through five corruption factors.
items.detailZh: 随着自动驾驶系统（ADS）的普及，未来的软件定义车辆（SDV）可能运行多个ADS，包括原生和售后市场系统，如Comma.ai的Openpilot。独立验证哪个自动驾驶系统处于活动状态的监控系统对于安全监控、法规合规、保险评估和异常检测至关重要。本文首先评估了三种基于序列的分类模型：门控循环单元（GRU）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和Transformer编码器模型，在仅使用车辆遥测数据识别Level 2自动驾驶系统（Comma Openpilot、Tesla Autopilot和Cadillac Super Cruise）以及手动驾驶方面的有效性。所有三种模型在干净数据上均表现出色，宏F1分数分别为0.92（GRU）、0.90（LSTM）和0.93（Transformer编码器模型）；威胁匹配训练在仅轻微降低干净数据性能的情况下，宏F1达到0.904-0.916。其次，文章引入了一个模块化鲁棒性评估框架，通过五种损坏因素模拟现实遥测数据退化，以评估模型在数据质量下降时的表现。
keyPointsZh: 三种模型在干净数据上均取得高宏F1分数（0.90-0.93）。
威胁匹配训练在轻微降低干净数据性能的情况下，宏F1达到0.904-0.916。
引入模块化鲁棒性评估框架，模拟五种遥测数据退化因素。
研究针对Level 2自动驾驶系统，包括Comma Openpilot、Tesla Autopilot和Cadillac Super Cruise。
items.impactZh: 该研究为自动驾驶系统识别提供了模型选择和鲁棒性评估的参考，有助于开发更可靠的安全监控系统。对于开发者而言，可以借鉴其威胁匹配训练方法以提高模型在数据退化情况下的鲁棒性。对于行业而言，该研究为法规合规和保险评估提供了技术基础。

items.titleOriginal: Guarantees on Dynamical System Distinguishability for LLM Token Generation
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work has shown that classifying large language models (LLMs)' responses can be distinguished by modeling token embeddings as trajectories of a black-box dynamical system (DS) and comparing prediction residuals of two DSs. Despite the empirical success of this dynamical approach, a theoretical understanding of why it works, how well it scales as a function of the token sequence, and when it transfers across embedding models remains lacking. We address these questions by formalizing the classification task as a binary hypothesis test between two stochastic linear DSs. We show that the total variation distance between the stationary marginal distributions of the two DSs can be arbitrarily small even when the dynamics differ substantially, which provides a fundamental accuracy floor for any classifier that ignores token dynamics. items.summaryZh: 最近的研究表明，通过将大语言模型（LLM）的响应令牌嵌入建模为黑盒动力系统（DS）的轨迹，并比较两个DS的预测残差，可以区分不同LLM的响应。尽管这种动力学方法在经验上取得了成功，但对其为何有效、如何随令牌序列长度扩展以及何时跨嵌入模型迁移的理论理解仍然缺乏。本文通过将分类任务形式化为两个随机线性DS之间的二元假设检验来解决这些问题。研究表明，即使两个DS的动力学差异显著，其平稳边际分布之间的总变差距离也可能任意小，这为任何忽略令牌动力学的分类器提供了基本的准确率下限。然后证明，基于DS的分类的误分类概率随序列长度L指数衰减，衰减速率由捕获两个DS之间谱距离的动力学可区分性量δ²决定。此外，还刻画了跨嵌入泛化的特性。

items.detailZh:
该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）响应分类问题，提出了一种基于动力系统（DS）的理论框架。作者将LLM的令牌嵌入序列视为黑盒动力系统的轨迹，并将分类任务形式化为两个随机线性DS之间的二元假设检验。论文首先证明了一个关键结果：即使两个DS的动力学参数差异显著，它们的平稳边际分布之间的总变差距离也可能任意小。这意味着任何仅基于令牌静态分布而不考虑动态信息的分类器，其准确率存在一个基本下限，无法区分动力学差异明显的模型。

接着，论文推导了基于DS的分类器的误分类概率上界，表明该概率随序列长度L指数衰减，衰减速率由动力学可区分性量δ²决定，该量反映了两个DS之间的谱距离。这一结果揭示了序列长度对分类性能的影响，并提供了理论上的性能保证。此外，论文还探讨了跨嵌入模型的泛化问题，即当使用不同的嵌入模型时，DS分类器的性能如何变化。

论文的贡献在于为LLM分类的动力学方法提供了坚实的理论基础，解释了其有效性，并给出了性能的定量描述。然而，论文主要基于线性DS假设，对于实际LLM的非线性动态可能不完全适用，且实验验证部分在摘要中未详细说明，因此其实际应用效果仍需进一步研究。
keyPointsZh: 将LLM响应分类形式化为两个随机线性动力系统之间的二元假设检验。
证明即使动力学差异显著，平稳边际分布的总变差距离也可能任意小，为忽略动态的分类器提供准确率下限。
推导出基于DS的分类误分类概率随序列长度指数衰减，衰减速率由谱距离δ²决定。
探讨了跨嵌入模型的泛化特性。
items.impactZh: 该研究为LLM响应分类的动力学方法提供了理论支撑，有助于理解为何基于动力学的分类有效，并指导如何选择序列长度和嵌入模型。对于开发人员，该理论可用于设计更高效的LLM指纹识别或模型归属方法。对于研究社区，它开辟了将动力系统理论应用于LLM分析的新方向。然而，由于理论基于线性假设，实际应用时需注意非线性效应。

items.titleOriginal: LAWFUL: Law-Aligned Witness for Faithful Use of Latents
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28672v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a neural network predicts a physical system accurately, has it learned the governing law as formal, structured knowledge, and if so, does the network's internal computation actually use that representation throughout the law's domain of validity? We identify four interpretability gaps that limit answering these questions for {\em physics laws over continuous variables}: the absence of a coverage-aware causal-consistency measure over continuous counterfactuals; of a domain-of-validity test for the identified circuit; of a verification of the law's invariants and forbidden behaviors; and of a quantification of how a derived physical quantity flows through the circuit. We develop a foundational framework, LAWFUL, that closes the first two and lays groundwork for the remaining two, and illustrate it on the Mocap2Radar transformer, validating whether it learns and internally uses the Doppler frequency law $f(t) = \frac{2 v(t)}{\lambda}$ from motion-capture and radar data in which neither $f(t)$ nor $v(t)$ appears.

items.summaryZh: arXiv:2607.28672v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：当神经网络准确预测物理系统时，它是否学到了作为形式化、结构化知识的控制定律？如果是，网络的内部计算是否在整个定律的有效域内实际使用了该表示？我们确定了四个可解释性差距，限制了回答这些关于连续变量物理定律的问题：缺乏对连续反事实的覆盖感知因果一致性度量；缺乏对所识别电路的域有效性测试；缺乏对定律不变量和禁止行为的验证；以及缺乏对派生物理量如何流经电路的量化。我们开发了一个基础框架 LAWFUL，它弥合了前两个差距，并为后两个奠定了基础，并在 Mocap2Radar 变压器上进行了说明，验证它是否从运动捕捉和雷达数据中学习并内部使用多普勒频率定律 f(t) = 2v(t)/λ，其中 f(t) 和 v(t) 均未出现。
items.summaryEn: arXiv:2607.28672v1 Announce Type: cross. Abstract: When a neural network predicts a physical system accurately, has it learned the governing law as formal, structured knowledge, and if so, does the network's internal computation actually use that representation throughout the law's domain of validity? We identify four interpretability gaps that limit answering these questions for physics laws over continuous variables: the absence of a coverage-aware causal-consistency measure over continuous counterfactuals; of a domain-of-validity test for the identified circuit; of a verification of the law's invariants and forbidden behaviors; and of a quantification of how a derived physical quantity flows through the circuit. items.detailZh:
该论文针对神经网络在预测物理系统时是否真正学习并内部使用物理定律的问题，提出了四个可解释性差距：缺乏覆盖感知的因果一致性度量、缺乏域有效性测试、缺乏对定律不变量和禁止行为的验证、以及缺乏对派生物理量流动的量化。作者开发了LAWFUL框架，旨在弥合前两个差距，并为后两个奠定基础。

LAWFUL框架在Mocap2Radar变压器上进行了验证，该模型从运动捕捉和雷达数据中学习，数据中并未直接包含多普勒频率f(t)或速度v(t)。论文验证了模型是否学习并内部使用多普勒频率定律f(t) = 2v(t)/λ。该框架通过因果一致性度量确保模型在连续反事实下保持一致，并通过域有效性测试确保电路在整个定律有效域内工作。

论文还讨论了如何验证定律的不变量和禁止行为，以及如何量化物理量在电路中的流动，但这些部分仅作为未来工作的基础。整体而言，LAWFUL为科学AI的可解释性提供了新的工具，有助于增强对模型预测的信任。
keyPointsZh: 提出了四个可解释性差距，限制了对连续变量物理定律的验证。
开发了LAWFUL框架，弥合了覆盖感知因果一致性和域有效性测试的差距。
在Mocap2Radar变压器上验证了多普勒频率定律的内部使用。
为验证定律不变量和物理量流动奠定了基础。
items.impactZh: 该研究对科学AI领域具有重要影响，提供了一种验证神经网络是否真正学习物理定律的方法，增强了模型的可信度。对于开发物理信息神经网络的开发者，LAWFUL提供了新的评估工具，有助于确保模型在物理上的一致性。对于工业应用，如雷达和运动捕捉系统，该框架可提高预测的可靠性。

items.titleOriginal: MPP-GNN: Subject-Adaptive Community Detection for fMRI-Based Alzheimer's Disease Classification
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28681v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is a widely used technique for studying the brain. Recent methods that utilize graph neural networks (GNNs) for analysis of brain functional connectivity have shown great potential for the classification of brain disorders, such as Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, these methods often assume a preset number of functional modules across all subjects, which overlooks inter-subject variability. In addition, the discovered modules are rarely used to directly guide the learned connectivity patterns. Here, to address these issues, we propose a Meta Probabilistic Pooling GNN (MPP-GNN). We frame the model's task as a coupled, bilevel optimization that performs adaptive graph partitioning hierarchically to discover subject-specific modules and then uses the discovered brain modules as an explicit prior to guide edge refinement and representation learning. We validate MPP-GNN on two public datasets for AD classification, achieving the highest AUC in comparison to established baselines for both datasets. items.author: Yang Zhang, Xiao Zhou, Jonathan Warrell, Avram Holmes, Xuan Zhang, Mark Gerstein

items.summaryZh: 该研究提出了一种元概率池化图神经网络（MPP-GNN），用于基于fMRI的阿尔茨海默病（AD）分类。现有方法通常假设所有受试者具有预设数量的功能模块，忽略了受试者间的变异性，且发现的模块很少直接用于指导学习到的连接模式。MPP-GNN将模型任务构建为耦合的双层优化，通过分层自适应图划分发现受试者特定的脑模块，并将这些模块作为显式先验来指导边细化和表示学习。在两个公共数据集上，MPP-GNN取得了最高的AUC，并与已知的脑功能模块显著对齐。
items.summaryEn: This research proposes a Meta Probabilistic Pooling GNN (MPP-GNN) for fMRI-based Alzheimer's disease (AD) classification. Existing methods often assume a preset number of functional modules across all subjects, overlooking inter-subject variability, and the discovered modules are rarely used to directly guide learned connectivity patterns. MPP-GNN frames the task as a coupled bilevel optimization, performing hierarchical adaptive graph partitioning to discover subject-specific modules, which are then used as explicit priors to guide edge refinement and representation learning. On two public datasets, MPP-GNN achieves the highest AUC compared to baselines and shows significant alignment with known brain functional modules.

将发现的模块作为显式先验指导边细化和表示学习。
在两个公共数据集上取得了最高的AUC。
与已知的脑功能模块显著对齐。
items.impactZh: 该研究为基于fMRI的脑疾病分类提供了新思路，通过考虑受试者间变异性，提高了分类性能，并增强了模型的可解释性。对神经影像分析和疾病诊断领域具有潜在的应用价值。

items.titleOriginal: Metaphor-Induced Algorithmic Steering: Cross-Domain Procedural Transfer in LLM Code Generation
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28683v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models benefit from elements in natural language, such as metaphors and analogies in training data and inference input to achieve generalisability across different domains. However, these language elements may also lead to unwanted behaviors when metaphorical expressions implicitly transfer inappropriate procedural patterns into new tasks. In this paper, we show that metaphorical instructions can induce analogical transfer of procedural mechanisms, thus steering code-generation models towards less efficient algorithms. We refer to this metaphor-induced effect as metaphorical algorithmic steering: a skill that is benign and plausible within its source domain transfers an abstract procedural schema into a programming task, causing the model to favor exhaustive search, full scans, or repeated reconstruction without explicitly mentioning the target algorithm. More broadly, this suggests that code-generation models can carry procedures that are appropriate in a task's background domain into the task's programming problem, where they can lead to unwanted outcomes. items.author: Zhibo Hu, Chen Wang, Yanfeng Shu, Hye-young Paik, Liming Dong, Liming Zhu
items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究揭示了一种新的LLM行为偏差机制，对代码生成模型的可靠性和安全性有重要影响，但属于预印本，尚未经过同行评审，且具体实验细节有限。
items.importanceReasonEn: The research reveals a novel mechanism of LLM behavioral bias with significant implications for code generation reliability and safety, but it is a preprint without peer review and limited experimental details.
items.titleZh: 隐喻引发的算法引导：LLM代码生成中的跨领域程序性迁移
items.titleEn: Metaphor-Induced Algorithmic Steering: Cross-Domain Procedural Transfer in LLM Code Generation
items.summaryZh: arXiv:2607.28683v1 预印本。研究表明，大型语言模型在训练数据和推理输入中利用隐喻和类比等自然语言元素实现跨领域泛化，但这些元素也可能导致不良行为，当隐喻表达隐式地将不适当的程序模式迁移到新任务中时。本文展示了隐喻指令可以诱导程序机制类比迁移，从而引导代码生成模型偏向低效算法。作者将这种隐喻诱导效应称为隐喻算法引导：源领域中良性且合理的技能将抽象程序模式迁移到编程任务中，导致模型偏好穷举搜索、全扫描或重复重构，而无需明确提及目标算法。更广泛地说，这表明代码生成模型可能将任务背景领域中的程序迁移到编程问题中，导致不良结果。为研究该现象，作者开发了MASC（隐喻算法引导）数据集。
items.summaryEn: arXiv:2607.28683v1 preprint. The paper shows that large language models benefit from natural language elements like metaphors and analogies for cross-domain generalization, but these elements can also lead to unwanted behaviors when metaphorical expressions implicitly transfer inappropriate procedural patterns into new tasks. The authors demonstrate that metaphorical instructions can induce analogical transfer of procedural mechanisms, steering code-generation models towards less efficient algorithms. They term this effect metaphorical algorithmic steering: a benign skill in the source domain transfers an abstract procedural schema into a programming task, causing the model to favor exhaustive search, full scans, or repeated reconstruction without explicit mention of the target algorithm.
items.detailZh: 该预印本（arXiv:2607.28683v1）研究了大型语言模型在代码生成中因隐喻和类比而导致的算法选择偏差。作者指出，LLM在训练和推理中利用自然语言中的隐喻和类比实现跨领域泛化，但这些语言元素可能隐式地将不适当的程序模式迁移到新任务中。他们通过实验证明，隐喻指令可以诱导模型采用源领域中合理的程序机制，但该机制在目标编程任务中效率低下，例如导致模型偏好穷举搜索、全扫描或重复重构，而无需明确提及目标算法。作者将这种现象称为“隐喻算法引导”，并开发了MASC数据集以系统研究该现象。摘要未提供具体实验设置、模型或结果细节，仅概述了现象和数据集。
keyPointsZh: 隐喻和类比在LLM中可导致跨领域程序性迁移，影响代码生成效率。
隐喻指令可能诱导模型采用低效算法，如穷举搜索或全扫描。
作者提出“隐喻算法引导”概念，并开发MASC数据集进行研究。
该研究为预印本，尚未经过同行评审，具体实验细节有限。
items.impactZh: 该研究对代码生成模型的可靠性和安全性有潜在影响，提示开发者在设计提示词时需注意隐喻可能带来的算法偏差。对于使用LLM进行代码生成的开发者，理解这一现象有助于避免因隐喻指令导致的性能下降。对于研究领域，该工作为理解LLM的推理偏差提供了新视角，并可能推动更稳健的提示工程和模型训练方法。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28687v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As populations age, cognitive decline from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia is a defining health challenge of the coming decades, yet routine assessment often misses its earliest signs. This article critically synthesizes recent technological advances for detecting and managing cognitive impairment in older adults, spanning neurophysiological signals (chiefly electroencephalography, EEG), structural and molecular neuroimaging (MRI and amyloid/tau PET), blood-based biomarkers, and digital markers, integrated through artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL). Beyond summarizing, it contributes a cross-disciplinary taxonomy, a methodological-rigor lens foregrounding subject- and site-independent validation, an integrative early-detection framework linking tiered screening to intervention, and comparison tables of detection methods, interventions, and risk and protective factors. items.summaryZh: 随着人口老龄化，从轻度认知障碍（MCI）到痴呆的认知衰退成为未来几十年的关键健康挑战，但常规评估常常错过其早期迹象。本文批判性地综合了近年来用于检测和管理老年人认知障碍的技术进步，涵盖神经生理信号（主要是脑电图EEG）、结构和分子神经影像（MRI和淀粉样蛋白/tau PET）、血液生物标志物以及数字标志物，并通过人工智能（AI）、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）进行整合。除了总结，本文还贡献了跨学科分类法、强调受试者和站点独立验证的方法学严谨性视角、将分层筛查与干预联系起来的整合早期检测框架，以及检测方法、干预措施和风险与保护因素的比较表。EEG标志物（α/θ变化、P300潜伏期）和深度模型（CNN、LSTM/BiLSTM、Transformer、自监督EEG基础模型）报告了较高的准确性，但许多依赖于小型、单站点数据集，可能无法泛化。

items.detailZh:
该论文发表于arXiv，类型为交叉研究，系统综述了用于老年人认知障碍检测和管理的最新科技进展。内容涵盖神经生理信号（主要是脑电图EEG）、结构和分子神经影像（MRI和淀粉样蛋白/tau PET）、血液生物标志物以及数字标志物，并通过人工智能（AI）、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）进行整合分析。论文不仅总结了现有技术，还提出了跨学科分类法，强调受试者和站点独立验证的方法学严谨性，并构建了将分层筛查与干预联系起来的整合早期检测框架。此外，论文还提供了检测方法、干预措施以及风险和保护因素的比较表。

论文指出，EEG标志物（如α/θ变化、P300潜伏期）和深度模型（如CNN、LSTM/BiLSTM、Transformer、自监督EEG基础模型）在检测认知障碍方面报告了较高的准确性，但许多研究依赖于小型、单站点数据集，可能无法泛化到更广泛的人群。因此，论文强调需要更严格的多中心验证和标准化协议，以确保技术的可靠性和临床适用性。

提出了跨学科分类法和整合早期检测框架，将分层筛查与干预相结合。
强调受试者和站点独立验证的重要性，指出许多研究基于小型单站点数据集。
EEG标志物和深度模型显示出较高准确性，但泛化性存疑。
items.impactZh: 对于研究人员，该论文提供了认知障碍检测技术的全面概览和未来研究方向。对于临床医生，整合早期检测框架可能有助于改进筛查和干预策略。对于开发者，论文中提到的深度模型和数字标志物可能启发新的诊断工具开发。

items.titleOriginal: Reflected UAS: Corrected Deterministic Stability and Direct CTMC Drift Calculation
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28688v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze Reflected UAS routing for heterogeneous multi-server queues at fixed parameters under subcritical load. The deterministic surrogate is a reflected ODE on the nonnegative orthant, not the unconstrained drift equation. This reflected ODE has a unique boundary equilibrium characterized by a scalar consistency equation and a convex-potential representation; all trajectories converge to it. The older argument lifting deterministic Lyapunov descent to CTMC stability fails: the exact generator applied to the deterministic potential produces a boundary term absent from the reflected-ODE descent identity. We give a direct Foster-Lyapunov drift inequality for the CTMC using a weighted-quadratic function, bypassing the failed lift. At the benchmark parameter point, the boundary equilibrium matches the numerical attractor to machine precision, and the default Reflected UAS policy has lower mean queue length than UAS and JSSQ across independent seed blocks.

该论文针对异构多服务器队列在次临界负载下的Reflected UAS路由策略进行了分析。作者指出，确定性替代模型应为反射ODE，而非无约束的漂移方程。反射ODE具有唯一的边界平衡点，由标量一致性方程和凸势表示刻画，所有轨迹收敛于该平衡点。

使用加权二次函数给出直接的Foster-Lyapunov漂移不等式。

items.titleOriginal: SEDR-Seq2P: A Lightweight Dilated Residual Sequence-to-Point Network for Multi-Task Industrial NILM
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28693v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Industrial NILM remains challenging because measurement noise and widespread concurrent machine operation reduce the generalization of models tuned on residential data. This work adopts a one-to-many, multi-task disaggregation setting, in which a single network estimates multiple industrial machine loads from aggregate power. Under a unified evaluation protocol on IMDELD, we benchmark Seq2Seq, Seq2SubSeq, Seq2Point, GRU, and WaveNet using energy-estimation metrics and the accuracy-delay criterion. While Seq2Point offers a stronger accuracy-delay balance than Seq2Seq/Seq2SubSeq, GRU and WaveNet achieve higher accuracy at markedly higher computational cost. To close this gap, we propose SEDR-Seq2P, a lightweight Seq2Point extension with dilated residual blocks and squeeze-and-excitation attention. Relative to the Seq2Point baseline, SEDR-Seq2P reduces MAE by approximately 7%, improves the coefficient of determination by approximately 1%, and increases the match rate by approximately 0.8%. items.summaryZh: 工业非侵入式负载监测（NILM）因测量噪声和机器并发运行而具有挑战性，降低了在住宅数据上训练的模型的泛化能力。本文采用一对多、多任务分解设置，即单个网络从总功率中估计多个工业机器负载。在IMDELD上的统一评估协议下，我们使用能量估计指标和准确率-延迟准则对Seq2Seq、Seq2SubSeq、Seq2Point、GRU和WaveNet进行了基准测试。虽然Seq2Point比Seq2Seq/Seq2SubSeq提供了更强的准确率-延迟平衡，但GRU和WaveNet以显著更高的计算成本实现了更高的准确率。为了缩小这一差距，我们提出了SEDR-Seq2P，一种轻量级的Seq2Point扩展，具有膨胀残差块和挤压激励注意力。相对于Seq2Point基线，SEDR-Seq2P将MAE降低了约7%，决定系数提高了约1%，匹配率提高了约0.8%。此外，与WaveNet相比，SEDR-Seq2P将推理延迟降低了约58%，为可扩展性提供了有利的准确率-延迟权衡。

items.detailZh: 工业非侵入式负载监测（NILM）旨在从总功率信号中估计单个设备的能耗，对于工业能源管理至关重要。然而，工业环境中的测量噪声和机器并发运行使得模型泛化困难，尤其是那些在住宅数据上训练的模型。本文采用一对多、多任务分解设置，即一个网络同时估计多个工业机器负载，以提高效率。在IMDELD数据集上，作者统一评估了多种现有方法，包括Seq2Seq、Seq2SubSeq、Seq2Point、GRU和WaveNet，使用能量估计指标（如MAE、决定系数）和准确率-延迟准则。结果表明，Seq2Point在准确率和延迟之间取得了较好的平衡，而GRU和WaveNet虽然准确率更高，但计算成本显著增加。为了在准确率和效率之间取得更好的折衷，作者提出了SEDR-Seq2P，它基于Seq2Point架构，引入了膨胀残差块和挤压激励注意力机制。实验结果显示，与Seq2Point基线相比，SEDR-Seq2P将MAE降低了约7%，决定系数提高了约1%，匹配率提高了约0.8%。与WaveNet相比，推理延迟降低了约58%，同时保持了有竞争力的准确率。这表明SEDR-Seq2P在工业场景中具有更好的可扩展性。
keyPointsZh: 工业NILM面临测量噪声和机器并发运行的挑战，模型泛化困难。
采用一对多、多任务分解设置，单个网络估计多个工业负载。
在IMDELD上基准测试了Seq2Seq、Seq2SubSeq、Seq2Point、GRU和WaveNet。
提出SEDR-Seq2P，结合膨胀残差块和挤压激励注意力，实现轻量级高准确率。
SEDR-Seq2P相比Seq2Point降低MAE约7%，相比WaveNet降低推理延迟约58%。
items.impactZh: 该研究为工业NILM提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案，有助于在资源受限的工业环境中部署实时负载监测系统。对于开发者而言，SEDR-Seq2P的轻量级特性意味着更低的硬件要求和更快的响应速度，适合边缘计算场景。对于工业界，该技术可提高能源管理效率，降低运营成本。

The GNLL objective reduces Expected Calibration Error by 76% comp

items.titleOriginal: WitCert: Sound Runtime Risk Observability and Gating for KV-Cache Quantization
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28699v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: KV-cache quantization is validated today by offline benchmark averages; a deployed system cannot tell whether compression is damaging the request it is serving right now. We give it a provably sound runtime meter, a "DTrace for KV quantization": a per-(layer, head, step) upper bound on the total variation between exact and compressed attention. The meter has two tiers: a deterministic band-norm-witness bound, sound for any cache-preserving black-box quantizer and for any query (adaptive-safe, worst-case Cauchy-Schwarz plus RoPE band-unitarity), and a tighter probabilistic certificate for a controlled subtractively-dithered INT8 quantizer under an explicit request-level failure budget (stated for non-adaptive queries; core theorems machine-checked in Lean 4). Three results. Observability: the meter enters SGLang through an environment-guarded patch, and any scheme registered as one tensor function is measured in live serving. Repair: meter-driven gating, risk-ranked where the witness is saturated and certified where it is informative, empirically restores the quality floor at benchmark scale. This paper proposes a provably sound runtime meter providing per-(layer, head, step) upper bounds on total variation between exact and compressed attention. The meter has two tiers: a deterministic band-norm-witness bound for any cache-preserving quantizer, and a probabilistic certificate for a controlled subtractively-dithered INT8 quantizer under explicit failure budgets. Results include observability (integrated into SGLang via environment-guarded patch), repair (meter-driven gating restores quality floor), and performance gains.
items.detailZh:
KV缓存量化是减少LLM推理内存占用的关键技术，但现有验证方法仅依赖离线基准平均值，无法在运行时检测压缩对当前请求的影响。本文提出WitCert，一种可证明可靠的运行时度量器，为每层、每头、每步提供精确与压缩注意力之间的总变差上界。该度量器包含两层：确定性带范数见证界，适用于任何保持缓存的量化器，且对任意查询自适应安全；以及针对受控减法抖动INT8量化器的概率证书，在显式请求级失败预算下成立，核心定理在Lean 4中机器验证。

研究在SGLang中通过环境守卫补丁集成度量器，实现实时可观测性。度量驱动的门控机制根据见证饱和度和证书信息性进行风险排序，在基准规模上恢复质量底线。例如，原始FP8转换从2%的准确率损失降至接近零。此外，概率证书在非自适应查询下提供更紧的界，但自适应查询下仍开放。
keyPointsZh: 提出WitCert，为KV缓存量化提供可证明的运行时风险度量器。
度量器提供每层、每头、每步的总变差上界，适用于任意保持缓存的量化器。
针对受控减法抖动INT8量化器，提供概率证书，核心定理在Lean 4中机器验证。
集成到SGLang，实现实时可观测性和门控修复，恢复质量底线。
实验显示原始FP8转换的准确率损失从2%降至接近零。
items.impactZh: 该研究为KV缓存量化提供了运行时安全保证，使部署系统能够实时检测压缩损害并采取修复措施。对开发者而言，可集成到推理框架中提升可靠性；对行业而言，推动量化技术在实际部署中的更广泛应用。

items.titleOriginal: Tool Specifications Matter: Uncovering and Mitigating Safety Risks in AI Agents
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.29254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents extend large language models (LLMs) with external tools, enabling them to perform complex tasks and translate model outputs into consequential real-world actions. Yet LLMs often become substantially less safe when deployed as agents, and the source of this degradation remains poorly understood. In this paper, we identify schema-formatted tool specifications as a primary source of agent safety degradation and show, through white-box representation analysis, that they weaken the model's internal refusal signals and contribute to unsafe tool execution. Building on this finding, we propose SafeKeep, an inference-time safeguard that decouples safety judgment from tool execution: it assesses requests using flattened textual tool specifications while retaining the original schema-formatted specifications for execution. Across two representative benchmarks and four LLMs, including both white-box and black-box models, SafeKeep increases the average refusal rate for harmful requests from 23.8% to 70.6% and reduces the average attack success rate under observation-level prompt injection from 25.6% to 2.5%. items.titleOriginal: MAGA: Multi-Platform Self-Fusion of GUI Agents via Structured Action Distillation
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.29320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents based on large language models are increasingly deployed across mobile, web, and desktop environments. However, existing agents are typically domain-specific, limiting the deployment and user experience. This motivates the consolidation of specialized models into a single cross-environment policy. Weight merging directly merges domain-specific experts but can corrupt executable actions under expert disagreement, while on-policy distillation (OPD) avoids conflicting teacher supervision yet still treats all response tokens equally during distillation, ignoring that action tokens are the only interface between the environment and the agent. To address this, We introduce MAGA that re-allocates training signal according to the structured action. Based on the correctness of the generated action, it suppresses unnecessary or invalid distillation signals and focuses learning on erroneous actions. Besides, a training-only hint optimizes the supervision signal provided by domain-specific teachers without changing the student input. items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.29405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic AI systems act through multi-step trajectories that combine planning, tool use, memory, interaction, and adaptation. This behavior stretches validation practice beyond component testing and one-shot input--output evaluation, because acceptable system behavior now depends on how decisions unfold over time and under changing environmental conditions. This survey synthesizes 257 papers spanning agent evaluation, software assurance, cyber-physical systems, runtime monitoring, and regulatory guidance in order to characterize the validation problem for agentic systems. The review is organized around a five-dimension taxonomy covering behavioral, safety, temporal, regulatory, and multi-agent concerns, and uses that taxonomy to map current approaches and expose recurrent coverage gaps. The analysis shows that behavioral evaluation is comparatively mature, while temporal validity, runtime evidence maintenance, regulatory legibility, and open-ended multi-agent systems assurance remain under-developed. items.titleOriginal: ModelEquivBench: Certifying Multi-Relational Evaluation of LLM-Generated Optimization Models
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.29431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate optimization models from natural language, but existing evaluation often reduces a generated model and its ground truth to a single equivalent/not-equivalent verdict or an execution-success rate--labels that are neither independently checkable nor faithful to the multiple distinct senses in which two formulations can agree. We present ModelEquivBench, a certifying, multi-relational evaluation system that reports a per-pair semantic profile E0--E6: model construction and exact ingestion (E0), verified representation alignment (E1), same-space and projected feasible-set relations (E2, E3), objective-order equivalence (E4), optimal-value equality (E5), and optimizer-set equivalence (E6). Each decided entry carries relation-appropriate, independently re-checkable evidence: replayable traces or explicit maps for E0--E1, exact-rational certificates for positive E2--E6 conclusions, and explicit witnesses for supported negatives. items.detailZh: 论文指出，现有评估方法通常将生成的模型与真实模型简化为等价/不等价的二元判定或执行成功率，这些标签既不可独立验证，也无法反映两个公式在多种不同意义上的等价性。为此，作者提出了ModelEquivBench，一个认证型多关系评估系统。该系统为每对模型生成一个语义档案E0–E6，包括：模型构建和精确输入（E0）、验证的表示对齐（E1）、同空间和投影可行集关系（E2、E3）、目标顺序等价（E4）、最优值相等（E5）和优化器集等价（E6）。每个判定都附带关系适当的、可独立复核的证据：E0–E1提供可重放轨迹或显式映射，E2–E6的正结论提供精确有理数证书，支持的负结论提供显式反例。对于不完整的映射搜索、不支持的结构和资源限制，系统返回类型化的UNKNOWN或N/A结果，而不是猜测。未满足的先决条件也会被报告为A（可能指'Abstain'或类似状态）。

对于不完整映射、不支持结构或资源限制，系统返回类型化的UNKNOWN或N/A，避免猜测。
items.impactZh: 该研究为LLM生成优化模型的评估提供了更严格和可验证的方法，有助于提高评估的可靠性和透明度。对研究人员而言，它提供了一种新的评估工具；对开发者而言，它可能用于验证模型生成的优化模型的质量，从而提升实际应用中的信任度。

items.titleOriginal: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.29440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring multimodal observations into queryable structures supporting filtering, aggregation, ranking, and temporal comparison. We present AdaMM, a framework that jointly supports retrieval and analytic memory. Rather than relying on application-defined schemas, AdaMM extracts provenance-linked attribute-value observations from dialogue, images, and contextual metadata, discovers recurring field structures, and materializes them for analytical access. At inference time, a memory-aware planner decomposes queries into retrieval and analytic operations and routes each operation to the appropriate tools.
